metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-ab[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Finish and land the dedicated beads sidecar[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every code path that locates a bead store's owning repository [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]handles the dedicated beads sidecar's repo-root layout, so unpushed[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bead commits survive workspace preparation, the ACE Plans tab [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]resolves and commits bead state correctly on migrated projects, and[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]epic sase-a8 is closed with its plan file marked done.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]land_beads_sidecar_epic.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Restore unpushed bead-commit protection for root-layout stores[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]prepare[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]prepare: teach the workspace-preparation preflight that a repository can[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]itself be the bead store, so local-only bead commits in the dedicated [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]beads clone are published or rescued before a clean and hard checkout [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]discards them.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop a README-only plans subdirectory from shadowing a flat [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]plans root[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]flatroot[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]flatroot: require a nested plans directory to hold month directories [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]before it disqualifies a flat plans sidecar root, so plan search and SDD[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]file listing stop returning nothing for a plans clone that carries a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]generated directory README.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Resolve the ACE Plans tab's plans root through the store[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]plansroot[dim] · [dim][/dim]after flatroot[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]plansroot: resolve each project's plans root through the SDD store [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of walking up from the bead directory, so linked plan documents,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cache keys, and the archive search all target the real plans clone.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Commit ACE scoped bead edits against the bead store's own [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]repository[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]acecommit[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]acecommit: resolve the owning git root from the bead directory instead [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]of assuming its parent, so bead updates submitted from the Plans tab are[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]actually committed and pushed rather than silently dropped.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Close the epic, sweep symbols, and mark the plan done[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]land[dim] · [dim][/dim]after prepare, flatroot, plansroot, acecommit[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]land: re-verify the split end to end, close bead sase-a8 without [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]forcing, clear whatever symvision reports once the epic whitelist [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]expires, and mark both plan files done.[/#D7D7AF]
